name: SGLang: Fast inference for LLMs and multimodal models
notes: SGLang is an open-source inference framework for LLMs, vision-language, and diffusion models. Optimized for agentic workloads, RL rollouts, large-scale serving. Supports NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, Intel, Apple Silicon. 36.8k stars. Includes SGLang Diffusion for image/video generation. Learned from vLLM, FlashInfer, Guidance, Outlines, LMQL.
